label: GPT-6 Astra (minimal loop)
explanation: Diagnosed severe repetitive rechecking: all 24 initial math replies exhausted 8192 tokens, often after valid deductions; an independent baseline set showed the same failure. Constructed an algebraic rank-one edit to model.layers.23.mlp.down_proj that conditionally encourages ending prolonged math thoughts. Its input direction comes from frozen restart activations with covariance-based controls, then is projected away from 303 protected final-answer/centroid states. Its output direction protects ordinary discourse and end-of-response token readouts. Held-out frozen-activation checks showed restart selectivity; no edited-model generation or network evaluation was performed. Upstream math computation and attention caches remain unchanged. The update norm is 2.648 versus a base Frobenius norm of 16.417. No gradients or iterative optimization were used; post-edit accuracy is unverified.
